# DISCITIS AND VERTEBRAL OSTEOMYELITIS

When possible, obtain diagnostic cultures before starting empiric therapy.
Obtain blood cultures, MRSA nares swab, and image guided aspirates or surgical bone biopsy.
Definitive therapy is based on culture and susceptibility test results.

_______________________________________________________________________________

## Duration of Treatment

- At least 6 weeks of pathogen directed IV/PO therapy
- Once culture and susceptibility testing is available switch to pathogen directed
therapy.
Therapy:
- Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h <AND> ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h
- If pseudomonas or gram-negative bacteria is suspected
    - Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h <AND> cefepime 2g IV q8h
